nodes.label: Design-parameter co-optimisation
nodes.rationale: Static vp fields are promoted to constant-over-lap decision variables solved jointly with the racing line via optimise_design(param_specs, tag) with param_specs=(vp_field, lower, upper); defaults brkB, Tdist, alpha_FL/FR/RW/TW; MLTP_TyreOptim promotes only Fz0_shift.

nodes.label: Config-dependent control vector
nodes.rationale: Control length varies with config: 1 or 4 motor torques (pt.EM4), T_brake, 4 ATD inputs if pt.ATD, 0/1/2/4 active-aero inputs per vp.ActAero, steering delta last; assembled in MATLAB order. Path-constraint count also changes with EM4/ATD.

nodes.label: Full Pacejka 5.2 tyre model (ctx.mf)
nodes.rationale: ~60 coefficients, combined slip on both axes, used only by vehModel.py.

nodes.label: Powertrain ratings (not a map)
nodes.rationale: Powertrain.py stores only 5 scalar ratings (Pmax, Tmax, OMmax, Vmax, eff); eff=0.9 is used only in the post-solve energy integral; actual power/rpm limits are enforced in MLTP.py/vehModel.py; pt.EM4/pt.ATD are set later by userOpts.

nodes.label: Simplified 8-parameter tyre (vp.tyre)
nodes.rationale: Lumped Magic-Formula tyre used only by vehModel_initial.py; must not be conflated with the full Pacejka ctx.mf.

nodes.label: ctx spine (single mutable Ctx)
nodes.rationale: A SimpleNamespace subclass replaces MATLAB's base workspace and is threaded through every stage; each stage mutates ctx in place and returns it. Namespaces: vp, pt, mf, aero, track, opts, Xi/Xf, m7/m23/data.

nodes.label: Degree vs radian field companions
nodes.rationale: Units are SI by convention only; some aero AoA and camber/toe fields are stored in degrees with separate *_rad companions, so mixing them is an easy bug.

nodes.label: Space-domain (arc-length) ODE formulation
nodes.rationale: Independent variable is arc-length s, so lap time becomes the integral of sf=(1-n*kappa)/(vx*cos(eps)-vy*sin(eps)) (dt/ds) over a fixed track length; every derivative in m.dx is multiplied by sf and sf is also the lap-time integrand L. Curvilinear coords: n lateral offset, eps heading error, kappa>0 left turn.

nodes.label: Stale root __init__.py
nodes.rationale: The root __init__.py imports .importfile/.collocation/.context which live under functions/, so importing the repo root as a package raises ImportError; import submodules directly as the tests do.

nodes.label: Two-stage solve (7-state warm start to 23-state)
nodes.rationale: A reduced 7-state bicycle model solves a cheap OCP whose solution is interpolated onto the 23-state grid as a warm start (Results/init_<circuit>.mat); MLTP() calls MLTP_initial(save=False) itself when warm_start=None. The init model is deliberately reduced, not obsolete.

nodes.label: Known limitation: linear_solver not forwarded to warm-start
nodes.norm_label: known limitation: linear_solver not forwarded to warm-start
nodes.rationale: MLTP did not forward linear_solver/hsl_dir into its internal MLTP_initial warm-start call, so the 7-state init used the userOpts default (ma57); only an explicit non-default solver failed to propagate. Declared out of scope.

nodes.label: Forward **useropts_kwargs to MLTP_initial
nodes.rationale: MLTP forwards its **useropts_kwargs (vp_overrides, circuits_dir, data_dir, linear_solver) to the internal warm-start MLTP_initial call so overrides apply to the 7-state model too, and gains a plots_dir kwarg passed to plotSDI.

nodes.label: DATA_AA.mat aerodynamic coefficients
nodes.rationale: Required for a real solve. vehParams only warns and falls back to placeholder Cd/Cl when missing, but vehModel raises RuntimeError if ctx.aero is None.

nodes.label: app/presets/default.json baseline preset
nodes.rationale: Generated one-off from vehParams.default_primaries() (the single source of truth) so it equals the baseline car; validated by test_presets.py (all keys known, values match, vehParams reproduces ms=1895); contains only the 51 primaries, not the Pacejka mf block.

nodes.label: Acceptance floor (clean VM, Sturn on MUMPS)
nodes.norm_label: acceptance floor (clean vm, sturn on mumps)
nodes.rationale: The built exe on a clean Windows VM with no Python must launch the GUI, run Sturn end-to-end with the MUMPS linear solver, stream the IPOPT log live, write results + plots to the Documents output folder and open a plot in the browser; HSL working in the frozen app is a stretch goal.

nodes.label: cfg.json solve configuration
nodes.rationale: GUI form -> RunConfig -> cfg.json -> headless_solve.py -> MLTP(**run_kwargs, vp_overrides=...). Three groups: run-config (circuit, AeroConfig, ATD, Electric_4Motors, TyreModel, vi, ni, linear_solver, save, plot, output_dir), Tier-1 tunables, and vp_overrides.

nodes.label: Expert config JSON file
nodes.rationale: Full vehParams overrides for power users live in editable JSON text files loaded via a 'Load config' picker on the Advanced tab; shipped default.json is the baseline car.

nodes.label: PyInstaller bundling (data + native libs)
nodes.rationale: Circuits/*.mat, Data/DATA_AA.mat and app/presets/*.json are collected and resolved at runtime via sys._MEIPASS; CasADi's compiled DLLs plus IPOPT/MUMPS are collected by the hook; build one-folder first (easier DLL debugging), then one-file for shipping.

nodes.label: Results summary + plot list (opened in browser)
nodes.norm_label: results summary + plot list (opened in browser)
nodes.rationale: Summary numbers (lap time, energy) parsed from the saved .mat plus a list of generated Plotly HTML plots each opened in the default browser; no embedded Chromium/QWebEngine.

nodes.label: Tier-1 tunables (7 GUI fields)
nodes.rationale: brkB, Tdist, ksD, alpha_FL, alpha_FR, alpha_RW, alpha_TW - vehParams primaries exposed as Setup-tab widgets in v1 instead of a 40-field form (YAGNI); folded into vp_overrides. Later superseded by the full vp dict.

nodes.label: vp_overrides dict
nodes.rationale: A single merged dict of vehParams primary/mf overrides threaded as a vp_overrides kwarg through userOpts and MLTP's **useropts_kwargs; a preset file is itself a vp_overrides dict; the Tier-1 GUI tunables fold into it before serialisation.

nodes.label: Changed-from-default highlighting
nodes.rationale: Driven purely by current value vs default so it stays correct after any reset, preset load or expert-file load; each field's valueChanged re-evaluates the bold/coloured style and the owning section's '(N changed)' badge; mirrors exactly what vp_overrides() will send.

nodes.label: Full vehicle-parameter editor (110 params)
nodes.rationale: Expands the Setup tab from 7 hardcoded tunables to every override vehParams accepts (51 primaries + 59 Pacejka 5.2 coefficients) in collapsible sections with reset, save/load presets, changed-from-default highlighting and tooltips/units; values flow through the existing vp_overrides path so no solve capability changes.

nodes.label: Override key set PRIMARY_KEYS u MF_KEYS
nodes.norm_label: override key set primary_keys u mf_keys
nodes.rationale: frozensets of default_primaries() and _default_mf() names; every vehParams override key (presets, expert files, GUI) is validated against their union and an unknown key raises ValueError rather than being silently ignored.

nodes.label: Solver & collocation options (max_iter, OPT_ds, OPT_d, OPT_e, tol)
nodes.norm_label: solver & collocation options (max_iter, opt_ds, opt_d, opt_e, tol)
nodes.rationale: Five knobs previously hardcoded in userOpts are exposed on the Advanced tab as top-level RunConfig/cfg.json fields (not vp_overrides) and plumbed as userOpts kwargs with identical defaults (6000, 30, 3, 1e-2, 1e-4); they apply to both the 7-state warm start and the 23-state solve. OPT_uinter and other IPOPT options stay hardcoded.

nodes.label: ATD + Electric_4Motors mutual exclusion
nodes.rationale: If ATD and Electric_4Motors are both On, userOpts forces ATD=Off with a warning.

nodes.label: Plain-script test convention (no pytest)
nodes.rationale: test_*.py are plain scripts whose asserts run at module top level via an ok(name, cond) helper; the finest selectable unit is a whole file and there is no run-all command. They cover only the casadi-free numerical/config core; symbolic models are smoke-tested separately.

nodes.label: Commit/push discipline
nodes.rationale: Commit a task only after its own test passes and the full test_*.py loop is green; push to origin/windows-app only in the final task after the entire suite passes.

nodes.label: Precision guard for spin defaults
nodes.rationale: huf/hur (0.2968771) are given decimals=7 and test_vp_params asserts every spin default is exactly representable at its decimals and that fmt_sci ('%.12g') round-trips all 110 defaults, preventing a spurious startup 'changed' flag or override.

nodes.label: Task order: registry -> widgets -> paths -> runconfig -> userOpts -> headless -> Setup tab -> Advanced tab
nodes.norm_label: task order: registry -> widgets -> paths -> runconfig -> useropts -> headless -> setup tab -> advanced tab
nodes.rationale: Between Task 4 (RunConfig rewrite) and Task 7 (Setup tab rebuild) app/mainwindow.py references removed names; acceptable because no test imports it until Task 7 and the app is not shipped mid-plan. Tasks 5 and 6 are independent of the GUI.

nodes.label: GUI disables ATD while 4-motors is On
nodes.norm_label: gui disables atd while 4-motors is on
nodes.rationale: ATD=On with Electric_4Motors=On is forbidden; the underlying code auto-flips ATD -> Off with a warning, so the GUI must instead disable the ATD control while 4-motors is On, leaving no silent change.

nodes.label: Frozen-path HSL resolution (sys._MEIPASS)
nodes.rationale: Bundle the Coin-HSL bin DLLs and patch functions/hsl.py to also resolve the DLL directory from the frozen root in addition to COINHSL_DIR / the seeded default; if HSL fails the existing MUMPS fallback keeps the exe solving, so HSL is a performance bonus, not a hard dependency.

nodes.label: Thin GUI layer / testable plain modules
nodes.norm_label: thin gui layer / testable plain modules
nodes.rationale: All non-Qt logic (config build/serialise, results parse) lives in plain modules that import without a display so they are unit-testable; Qt widgets are thin construction code and are not auto-tested (no display in CI).

nodes.label: Writable output dir (Documents\FullModelSim)
nodes.rationale: A frozen exe may live in read-only Program Files, where writing Results/ and Plots/ relative to the working directory would crash; default output_dir is %USERPROFILE%\Documents\FullModelSim, created on first run, editable in the GUI and passed through cfg.json; results panel reads from it.

nodes.label: Cd/Cl overwritten by DATA_AA.mat
nodes.rationale: Cd and Cl are overwritten from Data/DATA_AA.mat at solve time when present, so editing them usually has no effect; surfaced via tooltip only, no special-casing.

nodes.label: Diff-from-default override emission (expert < GUI)
nodes.rationale: vp_overrides() loads the expert file as the base layer, then adds only vp entries that differ from all_vp_defaults(); with the GUI at defaults the diff is empty so expert values pass through unchanged, while a GUI edit overrides the expert's value.

nodes.label: PARAM_GROUPS covers PRIMARY_KEYS u MF_KEYS exactly
nodes.norm_label: param_groups covers primary_keys u mf_keys exactly
nodes.rationale: The ordered (section, keys) registry must cover the override key set exactly once; a test enforces it so a parameter later added to vehParams without a group fails loudly instead of being silently omitted from the editor.

nodes.label: Two field kinds: spin vs sci
nodes.norm_label: two field kinds: spin vs sci
nodes.rationale: A QDoubleSpinBox stores its value rounded to its decimals setting, so it cannot represent tiny tyre coefficients (rHy1=-9.1492e-11, rVy5=-8.8234e-11, pHy2=0.00051596) or the 1e-6 epsilons - loading them would silently collapse to 0, corrupting the tyre model and producing a bogus changed-from-default diff. ParamMeta.kind selects QDoubleSpinBox ('spin') for well-scaled primaries and ScientificField ('sci', QLineEdit + ScientificNotation validator, '%.12g') for all MF_KEYS and eps_* keys; both share value()/setValue()/valueChanged.

nodes.label: Writable user presets dir
nodes.rationale: The bundled app/presets/ is read-only inside sys._MEIPASS when frozen, so user-saved presets go to ~/Documents/FullModelSim/presets/ (created on demand); loading reads from both directories.

nodes.label: RunConfig vp dict (single source of truth)
nodes.norm_label: runconfig vp dict (single source of truth)
nodes.rationale: Migrate the 7 named RunConfig fields into one vp dict seeded from all_vp_defaults(); TIER1_FIELDS and the named fields are removed. No persistence stored top-level brkB-style keys, so only test_runconfig.py needed rewriting.

nodes.label: Real circuits (.mat in Circuits/)
nodes.rationale: _REAL_CIRCUITS maps BCN to Barcelona_circuit.mat plus sector splits BCN_S1/S2/S3, Jarama, Spa, BCNAssetto.

nodes.label: CasADi
nodes.rationale: Symbolic modelling, ca.Function, nlpsol('ipopt'), collocation helpers; installed wheel is 3.7.2 (>=3.6 required).

nodes.label: Coin-HSL linear solvers (MA57/MA97/MA27)
nodes.rationale: HSL solvers factorise ~4-5x faster per IPOPT iteration than MUMPS; they need a Coin-HSL shared library (the MinGW/libgfortran5 CoinHSL_jll build matches the casadi wheel's ABI), located via COINHSL_DIR or the seeded default in functions/hsl.py. Licensed, free for academic use.

nodes.label: MUMPS linear solver
nodes.rationale: Bundled inside the casadi wheel and needs no external library, so it is the always-available fallback linear solver.

nodes.label: Synthetic circuits (analytic curvature)
nodes.rationale: Any circuit name not in _REAL_CIRCUITS is synthetic: curvature generated analytically by _synthetic_curvature (Straight, Hairpin, Sturn, Circle, ZigZag, ZigZagMirror, VirtualTrack); no .mat needed, so ideal for fast tests and benchmarks.

nodes.label: ctx.solve_stats / ctx.elapsed hook
nodes.rationale: MLTP previously discarded the solver object; the benchmark needs iter_count, return_status and per-callback wall times from solver.stats(), so MLTP stashes ctx.solve_stats and ctx.elapsed={'init','solve'}.

nodes.label: Linear-solver benchmark deliverable
nodes.rationale: Solve the real 23-state MLTP across mumps/ma57/ma97 on a small synthetic circuit and tabulate status, iteration count, wall time and the linear-solver vs function-eval split from solver.stats() t_wall_* timings, to confirm the bottleneck and quantify the win.

nodes.label: _hsl_dir private opts hint
nodes.rationale: userOpts carries only user intent: it sets ctx.opts['ipopt']['linear_solver'] and stashes the raw hsl_dir under the CasADi-invisible key ctx.opts['_hsl_dir']; _make_solver always pops it before nlpsol, so no path logic is duplicated in userOpts.

nodes.label: kaleido (optional static export)
nodes.rationale: Optional PNG/PDF export of Plotly figures via figure.write_image.

nodes.label: Plotly (interactive HTML figures)
nodes.rationale: Replaces the Simulink Data Inspector for result figures.

nodes.label: SciPy (.mat I/O, lfilter)
nodes.rationale: scipy.io loadmat/savemat and scipy.signal.lfilter for the moving-average curvature smoother.

nodes.label: Coin-HSL Linear Solver Integration - Implementation Plan
nodes.norm_label: coin-hsl linear solver integration - implementation plan

nodes.label: ma57 MC64 automatic scaling
nodes.rationale: ma57_automatic_scaling is set automatically in functions/hsl.py so MA57 converges on the stiff 23-state problem, where unscaled MA57 can stall.

nodes.label: Per-iteration linear-solver cost metric
nodes.rationale: The apples-to-apples benchmark metric: total wall-clock depends on how many iterations each solver takes on this nonconvex problem, so compare linear-solver cost per IPOPT iteration.

nodes.label: Task ordering: rewrite consumer before producer
nodes.norm_label: task ordering: rewrite consumer before producer
nodes.rationale: _make_solver must learn to pop the top-level _hsl_dir key before userOpts starts emitting it; otherwise CasADi would reject the unknown option and every solve would break. Hence Task 2 (consumer) precedes Task 3 (producer).

nodes.label: Probe success criterion
nodes.rationale: A trivial NLP solve must return return_status == 'Solve_Succeeded'; a failed HSL load returns 'Invalid_Option' (verified empirically), which the probe treats as failure and falls back to MUMPS.

nodes.label: Decision A1: env-var-first HSL config resolver
nodes.norm_label: decision a1: env-var-first hsl config resolver
nodes.rationale: HSL location resolves COINHSL_DIR env var -> explicit hsl_dir kwarg -> seeded default -> None, so configuration is portable across machines/clones and nothing machine-specific is required in committed code.

nodes.label: Proven Windows DLL loading recipe
nodes.rationale: Verified on CasADi 3.7.2: os.add_dll_directory(bin) + prepend bin to PATH + hsllib=full path to libhsl.dll solves on ma57/ma27/ma97. CasADi's bundled IPOPT already has IpLibraryLoader (no rebuild); the CoinHSL_jll v2024.5.15 MinGW/libgfortran5 bin is ABI-matched and self-contained (own OpenBLAS/METIS/gfortran runtime).

nodes.label: Problem: KKT factorisation dominates the 23-state solve
nodes.norm_label: problem: kkt factorisation dominates the 23-state solve
nodes.rationale: The 23-state solve was too slow with MUMPS because the symmetric-indefinite KKT factorisation dominates wall time; HSL is typically several times faster. The old _make_solver forced mumps and stripped hsllib/ma* as a defensive guard against a missing DLL crashing a solve.

nodes.label: ma86 excluded from defaults
nodes.rationale: ma86 segfaulted in a no-DLL loader probe, so only ma57/ma97/ma27/mumps are offered; ma57 is the default.

nodes.label: Decision B1: one-time pre-flight probe with MUMPS fallback
nodes.norm_label: decision b1: one-time pre-flight probe with mumps fallback
nodes.rationale: IPOPT loads HSL lazily at solve time, not at nlpsol construction, so a try/except around construction cannot catch a missing DLL. Instead solve a trivial 1-variable NLP with the requested solver+hsllib before the real solve; on DYNAMIC_LIBRARY_FAILURE/Invalid_Option/exception warn and downgrade opts to mumps. Cached per (solver, hsllib), ~1 ms once per process. Preserves the 'never crash on a missing DLL' guarantee.

nodes.label: _make_solver as the single solver chokepoint
nodes.rationale: All four MLTP entry points funnel through build_and_solve_nlp -> _make_solver -> nlpsol, so the linear-solver change is localised and benefits every script with no per-script edits.

nodes.label: Direct Legendre collocation transcription
nodes.rationale: Grid step OPT_ds=30 m, degree OPT_d=3, linear input interpolation; decision vector w=[Xk;Uk;(Yk);Xkj(;P)] packed column-major (order='F') to match MATLAB; NaN in Xi/Xf means a free boundary state; objective J=sum Qk*B*dsk + regularisation.

nodes.label: Minimum-Lap-Time Problem (MLTP)
nodes.rationale: Racing line posed as an optimal-control problem in the track arc-length domain, transcribed by direct Legendre collocation and solved as an NLP with IPOPT; a Python port of the MATLAB FullModel_4EM_Suspension_FullTyre framework.

nodes.label: build/windows-app.spec
nodes.rationale: datas: Circuits, Data, app/presets; collect_all for casadi, PySide6, plotly; hiddenimports scipy submodules + headless_solve; best-effort Coin-HSL DLLs when COINHSL_DIR is set at build time; Analysis entry app/main.py; onedir COLLECT named FullModelSim; console=True while debugging.

nodes.label: Clean-VM acceptance check
nodes.rationale: The frozen build was verified end-to-end on the dev machine (Sturn on ma57 from bundled Coin-HSL); a literal clean-VM run with no Python/casadi/HSL remains the gold-standard final acceptance check.

nodes.label: FullModelSim desktop app (PySide6 GUI)
nodes.rationale: The GUI writes a JSON config, spawns the solve as a subprocess, streams the IPOPT log into a log pane and lists the resulting plots; GUI runs write results and plots under %USERPROFILE%\Documents\FullModelSim.

nodes.label: Standalone Windows exe (PyInstaller onedir)
nodes.rationale: dist\FullModelSim\FullModelSim.exe runs on a machine with no Python; windowed by default (FMS_CONSOLE=1 for a console debug build); 'FullModelSim.exe --headless cfg.json' solves and exits, which is what the Run button spawns. Bundled Coin-HSL DLLs are found at sys._MEIPASS.

nodes.label: One exe, two entry modes (GUI / --headless)
nodes.rationale: The same frozen exe runs the GUI when launched normally and runs a solve then exits when launched with --headless <cfg.json>. The GUI spawns the solve by re-invoking itself (sys.executable + --headless) so no separate Python interpreter is needed on the target machine; a dev checkout spawns 'python headless_solve.py <cfg>' instead.

nodes.label: Subprocess solve with live log, Cancel = kill
nodes.norm_label: subprocess solve with live log, cancel = kill
nodes.rationale: Running the solve in a QProcess crash-isolates it from the GUI; merged stdout streams the IPOPT log live, Cancel kills the process (partial output left in output_dir), and a non-zero exit is reported while the log is kept for inspection.

nodes.label: Full 23-state vector
nodes.rationale: vx, vy, r, n, eps, Om_fl/fr/rl/rr, zs, zsdot, theta, thetadot, phi, phidot, wu_fl..rr, zt_fl..rr; no aux variables (ny=0). 4EM=four per-corner motors, Suspension=heave/pitch/roll+unsprung+tyre deflection, FullTyre=Pacejka 5.2 combined slip.

nodes.label: Normalised state/control scaling
nodes.rationale: x/u are scaled symbols; physical values (vx=100*vx_n) are reconstructed inside the equations and m.dx is divided by the scale vector; optimal values must be rescaled with m.x_s/m.u_s.

nodes.label: Wheel-radius / gear quirk (intentional)
nodes.rationale: Powertrain sets vp.Rw=0.3142857 and derives vp.gear from it; vehParams then overwrites vp.Rw=0.355 but deliberately does not recompute gear. test_params_useropts.py asserts this; do not 'fix'.

nodes.label: vehParams two-phase refactor (primaries + overrides -> derived)
nodes.rationale: Safety-critical: vehParams hardcoded primaries and computed derived quantities (ms, m, l_f, l_r, dampers, m_eff, static loads, xti/xsi/lsi, mirrored camber) inline, so applying overrides afterwards would leave every derived value stale - silent wrong physics. Fix: build a primaries dict, merge vp_overrides into it, then derive everything from the merged dict. Contract: byte-for-byte defaults with no overrides (incl. the Rw/gear quirk and Copy-B tyre set), unknown keys raise, mf block overridable but absent from default.json.

hyperedges.label: Canonical ctx driver order (Powertrain -> vehParams -> userOpts -> vehModel|vehModel_initial -> MLTP*)
GUI configuration flow (widgets -> RunConfig -> cfg.json -> headless_solve -> MLTP -> vehParams/userOpts)
